narrative.offerRewardText: From the ground near the gong springs a special crystal. Perhaps favor from the Brood.
narrative.requestItemsText:
The Scarab Gong looms ominously before you. Steel yourself, adventurer; for once the Scarab Gong is rung, the gates of Ahn'Qiraj will be opened.

From the slackened maw of the beast can only come chaos and destruction. Defend your people!

chain.subtitle: 23 quests at level 60, 131,850 XP in all.

quests.name: What Tomorrow Brings
quests.objectiveText: Venture to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris and find Anachronos, Brood of Nozdormu.

quests.name: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the continent of Teldrassil and find Malfurion's agent somewhere outside the walls of Darnassus.

quests.name: Only One May Rise
quests.objectiveText: Return the Head of the Broodlord Lashlayer to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

quests.name: Tyrande and Remulos
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Moonglade and speak to Keeper Remulos.

quests.name: The Path of the Righteous
quests.objectiveText: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.

quests.name: Draconic for Dummies
quests.objectiveText: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.

quests.name: The Nightmare's Corruption
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the four Emerald Dream portals in Azeroth and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's Corruption from each.

quests.name: Anachronos
quests.objectiveText: Seek out Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

quests.name: rAnS0m
quests.objectiveText: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Long Forgotten Memories
quests.objectiveText: Locate the Crystalline Tear in Silithus and gaze into its depths.

quests.name: Decoy!
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to travel to Winterspring and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.

quests.name: The Champion Returns
quests.objectiveText: Take the Green Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

quests.name: A Pawn on the Eternal Board
quests.objectiveText: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Only Prescription
quests.objectiveText: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothf

quests.name: The Good News and The Bad News
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.

quests.name: The Wrath of Neptulon
quests.objectiveText: Use the Arcanite Buoy at the Swirling Maelstrom at the Bay of Storms in Azshara.

quests.name: Nefarius's Corruption
quests.objectiveText: Slay Nefarian and recover the Red Scepter Shard.

objectiveItems.name: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands
